title: Biliary Surgery Mastery
description: Operative videos, courses and training in complex laparoscopic gallbladder and bile duct surgery.

hero.heading: Learn the difficult gallbladder from the surgeon who graded it.
hero.text: Operative video, indexed by difficulty grade and teaching point, from a thirty-year series of laparoscopic cholecystectomy and bile duct exploration. Every case is a real operation, chaptered so you can go straight to the step you need.

credentials.label: Patients graded in the GECKO study

governance.title: Anonymised at source
governance.text: No patient identifiers appear in any frame, title, cholangiogram or chapter note.

governance.title: Consent documented
governance.text: Educational-use consent is recorded for every operation before it enters the library.

governance.title: Secure video hosting
governance.text: Video is hosted on a secure service and embedded on this site. Downloads are disabled.

governance.title: Professional audience
governance.text: Operative content is intended for surgeons and surgical trainees.
